body.personMessage:
The held write was not approved yet, so nothing was applied.
Approve it with your passkey here; the page then shows a code for the agent:

http://localhost:8787/approvals/<id-5>#<fragment>

Or run: basalt approve --agent bot --config /etc/basalt-test/engine.json --open <id-5>
